featureSorter.description: MC FeatureSorter: first-seen feature IDs, consecutive edges across each full biome feature sequence, DFS roots/successors ordered by (step,globalId), reverse postorder.
featureSorter.runtimeCaveat: TFGBiomes.TFG_EXTENSIONS is an IdentityHashMap, so live possible-biome order can differ. Tag resources are merged in lexicographic mod-jar filename order; KubeJS processing includes literal feature-tag additions/removals, underground fluid-vein additions and the expanded palm-fruit biome loop from registerTFGOverworldPlacedFeatures. Other dynamic KubeJS biome-tag additions are excluded because applying every script event as a raw tag list produced a cyclic graph; actual runtime ordering/semantics must be captured to match live indices. These indexes and memberships are exact for the documented extraction inputs, not a captured runtime profile. The selected profile resolves the two parallel spring indices against saved World 0 geometry using a source-legal encounter-order witness; the complete live JVM order is not captured.

seedAlgorithm.hash: h=salt XOR ((long)x*501125321) XOR ((long)y*1136930381) XOR z; h*=0x27d4eb2d; return sign-extended (int)h
seedAlgorithm.feature: random.setSeed(base); s=(index*random.nextLong()*203704237L) XOR (step*random.nextLong()*758031792L) XOR base; random.setSeed(s)
seedAlgorithm.random: WorldgenRandom wrapping XoroshiroRandomSource; same random passed through feature placement and reseeded per feature.
